audioPanel.noiseHint: Removes steady hiss and hum when exporting; the preview plays the original. Strong settings can thin out quiet speech.
audioPanel.noiseHintMic: Removes steady hiss and hum from the microphone when exporting; the preview plays the original. Strong settings can thin out quiet speech.
audioPanel.loudnessHint: A standard loudness ({lufs} LUFS) for YouTube and social apps. The preview approximates it; the export measures it exactly.

voice.intro: Removes fan hum, keyboard and mouse clicks and room noise from your voice, on this PC. The preview plays the result.
voice.mixed: This recording keeps your microphone and the PC's sound together, so both are cleaned.
voice.silent: The recording is silent, so there is no voice to clean.
voice.noMic: The microphone is muted or was not recorded, so there is no voice to clean.
voice.ready: Your voice is clean. The preview and the export use it.
voice.playingOriginal: Playing the original voice. The export stays clean.
voice.stopped: Cleaning stopped. The preview plays the original voice, and the export cleans it first.
voice.strength.lightHint: Softens the noise and keeps some of the room.
voice.strength.normalHint: Removes most noise. Right for most recordings.
voice.strength.strongHint: Removes as much as it can. Quiet words can sound thin.
